plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.general_objectives: Familiarise with search engines and browsers
plan.specific_objectives: Identify and use various types of search engines (e.g., Google, Bing) and browsers (e.g., Chrome, Firefox)
plan.main_topic: 1.1 Familiarising with various types of search engines and browsers

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students whether they have ever searched for information on a computer or phone and how they did it.
Explains the difference between a search engine and a browser, demonstrating how to open a browser and run a search on Google and Bing.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take detailed notes and follow the demonstrations.
teaching_structure.assessment: Correct identification of search engines and browsers

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pairs in performing a practical search for a given topic using a search engine.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Run a guided practical search in pairs.
teaching_structure.assessment: Correct completion of the search task

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews pair results, addresses errors, and consolidates the key points on the board.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present search results and answer questions.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Open a browser, type a query, and find information on a given topic
plan.main_topic: 1.1 Familiarising with various types of search engines and browsers

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps search engines versus browsers from the first double period.
Demonstrates the full steps of a search: open browser, type the query, read results, open a page, and save useful information.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes on the search steps.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups through a practice search on the topic of their school community.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Perform a practice search in groups.
teaching_structure.assessment: Correct application of the search steps

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews group findings and consolidates on the board.

topics.topic_name: 1C: REVIEW OF SEARCH ENGINES AND BROWSERS

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Name search engines and browsers and state one use of each
plan.main_topic: 1.1 Familiarising with various types of search engines and browsers

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the practical searches done in the double periods.
Reviews the key terms (search engine, browser) and their uses with oral examples.
Poses oral questions about search engines and browsers to individual students.
teaching_structure.assessment: Ability to distinguish search engines and browsers

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Gives feedback and previews next week's topic (searching for general information).

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.general_objectives: Utilise ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Search for general information on given topics using ICT tools
plan.main_topic: 1.2 Utilising ICT tools to search for general information

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students what kind of general information they would like to search for using a computer.
Explains and demonstrates how to search for general information (school news, geography facts, health tips) using ICT tools.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take detailed notes and follow the demonstration.
teaching_structure.assessment: Correct understanding of general information search

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups in searching for information on a given topic card.
Reviews the information found by each group and gives feedback.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present information found to the class.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Organize and present general information found through a search
plan.main_topic: 1.2 Utilising ICT tools to search for general information

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the information each group searched for in the first double period.
Guides students on how to organize and report the information they found (what it is, where it came from, whether it is useful).
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes on how to report findings.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups to prepare a short written report of their findings.
Reviews group reports with the class.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Oral quiz on search engines, browsers and general information search
plan.main_topic: 1.2 Utilising ICT tools to search for general information

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the reports done in the double periods.
Leads a rapid oral review of how to search for general information.
Continues the oral quiz covering remaining points.
Gives feedback and previews Chapter Two (Listening to various types of information).

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Listen to oral presentations/tasks and answer questions based on them
plan.main_topic: 2.1 Answering questions based on information from presentations/tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students what they do when their teacher reads a story aloud to the class.
Explains the importance of careful listening and plays/delivers a short oral text, giving guiding questions before listening.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Listen attentively and note key ideas.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Poses comprehension questions based on the oral text and guides pair discussion of answers.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Answer questions and discuss in pairs.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews answers as a class and consolidates key points.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Respond appropriately to questions raised from oral presentations and tasks
plan.main_topic: 2.1 Answering questions based on information from presentations/tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the oral text from the first double period.
Guides students through responding to questions from a new oral presentation, using prompt phrase frames (e.g., "The speaker said that...").
Guides pair work in which one partner asks questions and the other responds.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Ask and respond to questions in pairs.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews a few pairs and gives class feedback.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Answer short oral/written questions on a brief oral text
plan.main_topic: 2.1 Answering questions based on information from presentations/tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the listening strategies used in the double periods.
Delivers a brief oral text and guides answering of short questions.
Administers short written questions based on the text.
Reviews answers with the class.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Respond appropriately to questions raised from presentations/tasks
plan.main_topic: 2.2 Responding to questions from others

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students to describe how they feel when someone asks them a direct question in class.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Share feelings about being asked questions.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Explains the features of a good oral response (clear, relevant, polite, complete) and models examples.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes on features of good responses.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides role plays in which students ask each other questions and respond using prompt cards.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Practise asking and responding in role plays.
teaching_structure.assessment: Appropriateness of responses in role play

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews selected role plays and consolidates on the board.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present role plays to the class.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Practise responding to questions from a freshly presented task
plan.main_topic: 2.2 Responding to questions from others

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the features of a good oral response.
Presents a short task and demonstrates appropriate ways of responding to its questions.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the demonstration and note response frames.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pair interviews where students ask and answer questions from the task.
Reviews pair interviews and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Oral practice of responding to short questions
plan.main_topic: 2.2 Responding to questions from others

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the pair interviews from the double periods.
Models a rapid question-and-answer exchange.
Poses short questions to individual students.
teaching_structure.assessment: Ability to respond clearly and relevantly

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Gives feedback and previews pronunciation work (2.3).

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Pronounce words correctly by imitating oral, audio and audio-visual sources
plan.main_topic: 2.3 Practising pronunciation of words from oral, audio and audio-visual sources

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students to pronounce a few common words aloud and discuss why pronunciation matters.
Explains correct pronunciation and plays audio/audio-visual recordings of target words, demonstrating clear pronunciation.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Listen and imitate the correct pronunciation.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides choral and individual repetition of the target words using word cards.
Selects students to pronounce words and corrects errors.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Practise pronunciation of words with correct word stress and difficult sounds
plan.main_topic: 2.3 Practising pronunciation of words from oral, audio and audio-visual sources

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the target words from the first double period.
Explains word stress and tricky sounds, playing audio examples for imitation.
Guides pair drills in which students listen, repeat, and check each other's pronunciation.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Practise in pairs with word cards.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews pair drills and consolidates the correct pronunciations.

plan.competence: 1.0 Using ICT tools to search for information
plan.specific_objectives: Short pronunciation check of target words
plan.main_topic: 2.3 Practising pronunciation of words from oral, audio and audio-visual sources

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the pronunciation drills from the double periods.
Reviews remaining pronunciation difficulties.
Administers a short oral pronunciation check.
Gives feedback and previews Chapter Three (Producing short and coherent oral messages).

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Form simple and coherent oral sentences using correct word order
plan.main_topic: 3.1 Forming simple structures

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students to put a few scrambled words into a correct sentence on the board.
Explains the basic subject-verb-object word order and models simple oral sentences.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes on word order and follow the models.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups in arranging sentence strips to form correct sentences and saying them aloud.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Arrange and say sentences in groups.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews group sentences and corrects mistakes.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Form and say a variety of simple sentences using given vocabulary
plan.main_topic: 3.1 Forming simple structures

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps subject-verb-object order from the first double period.
Models forming sentences from given word cards and expands to negatives and questions.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the models and take notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides substitution drills in pairs with word cards.
Reviews pair work and administers oral sentence checks.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Form simple sentences individually from given words
plan.main_topic: 3.1 Forming simple structures

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the sentence drills from the double periods.
Reviews common mistakes in sentence ordering.
Guides individual formation of sentences from word cards.
Gives feedback and previews 3.2 (Producing short oral messages).

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Produce short oral messages on particular topics (e.g., introducing oneself) with intelligible pronunciation and fluency
plan.main_topic: 3.2 Producing short oral messages on particular topics

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students to introduce themselves in one or two sentences.
Explains the structure of a short oral message (greeting, main content, closing) using the example of self-introduction.
Guides students to prepare and practise introducing themselves using prompt cards.
Selects students to present their introductions and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Produce short oral messages on topics such as describing one's family
plan.main_topic: 3.2 Producing short oral messages on particular topics

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the structure of a short oral message.
Models a short message describing one's family with correct pronunciation and fluency.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the model and take notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pairs to prepare and practise short messages about their families.
Reviews selected pairs and consolidates on the board.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Produce a very short oral message about oneself individually
plan.main_topic: 3.2 Producing short oral messages on particular topics

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the messages practised in the double periods.
Reviews pronunciation and fluency issues noted.
Guides individual production of a very short self-introduction.
teaching_structure.assessment: Fluency and clarity of the message

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Collects key feedback and previews Chapter Four (Developing vocabulary).

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Write new vocabulary from conversations and written texts on particular topics
plan.main_topic: 4.1 Writing new vocabulary from conversations and written texts

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students which new English words they heard yesterday outside class.
Explains how to identify and note new vocabulary while listening to conversations and reading texts, and how to record meanings.
Guides groups through reading a short text and writing a list of new words with their guessed meanings.
Reviews the lists, corrects meanings, and consolidates on the board.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present word lists and check meanings.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Write new vocabulary from a dialogue and check meanings in dictionaries
plan.main_topic: 4.1 Writing new vocabulary from conversations and written texts

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps how to record new vocabulary.
Reads/acts a short dialogue and guides noting of new vocabulary with dictionary checks.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Note new words and look up meanings.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pairs in extracting and defining new words from the dialogue with dictionaries.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Extract and define words in pairs.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews pair work and gives feedback.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present word definitions to the class.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Short dictation and word-list check
plan.main_topic: 4.1 Writing new vocabulary from conversations and written texts

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the vocabulary work from the double periods.
Clarifies remaining difficulties with the recorded words.
Administers a short dictation of the week's words.
Reviews the dictation and previews 4.2 (Constructing sentences).
teaching_structure.student_activities: Self-check work and listen to preview.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Construct sentences using vocabulary acquired from conversations and written texts
plan.main_topic: 4.2 Constructing sentences using vocabulary acquired

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students to use one of the week's new words in a sentence.
Explains how to construct correct sentences with new vocabulary (subject-verb-object, tense agreement).
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes and follow the models.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups in constructing sentences with the new vocabulary using flash cards.
Reviews group sentences and corrects errors.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Construct written sentences using vocabulary acquired from conversations
plan.main_topic: 4.2 Constructing sentences using vocabulary acquired

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the sentences built in the first double period.
Models written sentence construction and guides correction of common errors.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the models and take notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides individual writing of sentences using the acquired vocabulary.
Reviews written sentences and gives feedback.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Read aloud and check their written sentences.

plan.competence: 2.0 Producing short and coherent oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Short exercise constructing sentences with new words
plan.main_topic: 4.2 Constructing sentences using vocabulary acquired

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the sentence-writing practice.
Clarifies remaining grammar points for sentence construction.
Administers a short written exercise.
Gives feedback and previews mid-term and Chapter Five.

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Use proper grammar (tenses, articles, pronouns, prepositions) in oral and written language tasks
plan.main_topic: 5.1 Using appropriate grammar in oral and written language tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews Term I work up to the mid-term and asks students to name any English tense they know.
Explains key grammar points (simple present, simple past, articles, pronouns, prepositions) with oral examples.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take detailed notes on each grammar point.
teaching_structure.assessment: Correct understanding of the grammar points

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups in completing grammar tasks (filling gaps, correcting sentences) on charts.
Reviews group answers and consolidates on the board.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present answers and explain their choices.

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Write short sentences using the grammar points learned
plan.main_topic: 5.1 Using appropriate grammar in oral and written language tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the grammar points from the first double period.
Models writing sentences using correct tenses, articles and prepositions and explains common errors.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the models and take notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides individual writing of short sentences using the grammar points.
Reviews written work and gives feedback.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present and check their written sentences.

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Short grammar exercise on tenses, articles and prepositions
plan.main_topic: 5.1 Using appropriate grammar in oral and written language tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the grammar practice from the double periods.
Clarifies remaining grammar difficulties.
Administers a short grammar exercise.
Gives feedback and previews 5.2 (Using appropriate vocabulary).

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Use appropriate vocabulary relating to a specific context in oral and written tasks
plan.main_topic: 5.2 Using appropriate vocabulary in oral and written language tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Shows pictures of different contexts (school, market, hospital) and asks students to name words connected to each.
Explains how to choose appropriate words for a specific context and models example sentences.
Guides groups in matching context vocabulary to pictures and constructing sentences.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Match and construct sentences in groups.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews group work and consolidates on the board.

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Write short passages using appropriate context vocabulary
plan.main_topic: 5.2 Using appropriate vocabulary in oral and written language tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the context vocabulary from the first double period.
Models writing short passages (e.g., describing a visit to the market) using appropriate vocabulary.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the models and take notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pairs to write short passages on a chosen context.
Reviews pair passages and gives feedback.
teaching_structure.assessment: Quality of vocabulary use in passages

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Short vocabulary exercise (word-picture matching and sentence completion)
plan.main_topic: 5.2 Using appropriate vocabulary in oral and written language tasks

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the passages written in the double periods.
Clarifies remaining vocabulary usage issues.
Administers a short vocabulary exercise.
Gives feedback and previews Chapter Six (Reading texts for comprehension).

topics.topic_name: 12A: IDENTIFYING MAIN IDEAS AND SUPPORTING DETAILS

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Identify main ideas and supporting details from a text
plan.main_topic: 6.1 Identifying main ideas and supporting details
plan.teaching_aids: A variety of texts, selected readers.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students what they think the main idea of a text is.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Share initial ideas about main ideas.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Explains main ideas versus supporting details and demonstrates identifying them in a short text.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes and follow the demonstration.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups in reading a text and identifying its main idea and supporting details.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Read and identify main ideas in groups.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews group findings and consolidates on the board.

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Identify main ideas and supporting details in a second text
plan.main_topic: 6.1 Identifying main ideas and supporting details

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps main ideas versus supporting details.
Guides guided reading of a second text, spotting the main idea and details together.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Read along and follow the analysis.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pair work to find the main idea and details of a further short text.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Work in pairs on the short text.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews pair findings and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Short task: state the main idea of a short text
plan.main_topic: 6.1 Identifying main ideas and supporting details

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the reading tasks from the double periods.
Reviews how to state a main idea in one sentence.
Administers a short main-idea task on a short text.
Gives feedback and previews 6.2 (Inferring meanings).

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Infer meanings of unfamiliar words and expressions from a text using context clues
plan.main_topic: 6.2 Inferring meanings of unfamiliar words

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students what they do when they meet an English word they do not know in a story.
Explains context clues (definition, synonym, example, contrast) used to infer meanings of unfamiliar words.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes on the types of context clues.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups in inferring the meanings of underlined words in a text using context clues.
Reviews group answers, reconciling them with dictionary checks.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present inferred meanings and check in dictionaries.

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Complete comprehensive revision of Term I content and the Term I revision test
plan.main_topic: 6.2 Inferring meanings of unfamiliar words

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Outlines the topics covered in Term I (ICT information search, listening, oral messages, vocabulary, grammar, reading comprehension).
Leads a rapid review of key Term I competences through guided Q&A.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Answer questions and take additional notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Supervises students completing the Term I revision test.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Complete the Term I revision test.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Collects the tests and previews Term II content (oral comprehension, responding, oral communication grammar/vocabulary, text creation).
teaching_structure.student_activities: Listen to the Term II preview.

plan.competence: 3.0 Using appropriate grammar and vocabulary in oral and written contexts
plan.specific_objectives: Review the revision test and pronounce the end of Term I
plan.main_topic: 6.2 Inferring meanings of unfamiliar words

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the Term I revision test from the double period.
Reviews the revision test answers with the class.
Addresses common errors and answers final questions.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Ask clarifying questions on weak areas.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Wishes students a good break and previews Term II.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Listen to the Term II preview.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Synthesise ideas from a variety of oral sources (e.g., presentations, recordings, radio, TV)
plan.main_topic: 7.1 Synthesising ideas from a variety of oral sources
plan.teaching_aids: Audio and audio-visual materials (recorded presentations, radio clips), notebooks.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Plays a short recorded presentation about a local topic and asks students to name the main points they heard.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Share the main points they heard.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Explains what synthesising oral information means (combining and connecting ideas from different oral sources on the same topic) and models how to compare and join the main points of two short recordings.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take detailed notes and follow the modelling.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Plays two short audio clips on the same topic and guides groups in listing and combining the main ideas from both.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Work in groups, listing and combining the main ideas from the two clips.
teaching_structure.assessment: Completeness of the synthesised main ideas

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews group contributions, draws a combined summary map on the board and consolidates the key steps.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present group ideas to the class.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Synthesise ideas from a recorded presentation in pairs
plan.main_topic: 7.1 Synthesising ideas from a variety of oral sources
plan.teaching_aids: Audio and audio-visual materials (recorded presentations, radio clips), notebooks.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the steps for synthesising ideas from the first double period.
Plays a slightly longer recorded presentation and demonstrates how to pick out key ideas, re-state them in one's own words and connect related points.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the demonstration and note key phrases.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pairs in synthesising the presentation into three or four combined points written in their own words.
Reviews pair summaries, addresses errors and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Give a short oral synthesis of a short recorded talk
plan.main_topic: 7.1 Synthesising ideas from a variety of oral sources

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the group synthesis from the double periods.
Clarifies difficulties in distinguishing key ideas from supporting examples.
Plays a short clip and asks students to state its main ideas orally and combine them.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Give a short oral synthesis individually.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Gives feedback and previews 7.2 (Summarising information from oral sources).

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Summarise information from a variety of oral sources
plan.main_topic: 7.2 Summarising information from oral sources
plan.teaching_aids: Audio and audio-visual materials, summarising practice sheets.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Plays a short announcement and asks students to say in one sentence what it was about.
Explains what a summary is (a brief restatement of the key ideas) and how it differs from retelling the whole passage, modelling summarising a short recorded passage.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes on the rules of summarising.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Plays an audio passage and guides pairs in writing a three or four sentence summary.
teaching_structure.assessment: Coverage of key ideas in the summary

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews pair summaries, compares their lengths and consolidates the key points on the board.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Produce an oral and written summary of a recorded interview
plan.main_topic: 7.2 Summarising information from oral sources
plan.teaching_aids: Audio and audio-visual materials, summarising practice sheets.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the summarising rules from the first double period.
Plays a recorded interview and demonstrates selecting the speaker's main ideas and supporting examples into a short summary.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the demonstration and take notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pairs in summarising the interview orally and then writing the summary down.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Summarise the interview in pairs, orally then in writing.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Collects and reviews several written summaries and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Write a short summary of a short talk
plan.main_topic: 7.2 Summarising information from oral sources

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the interview summaries from the double periods.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Recall what makes a good summary.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Clarifies the difference between main ideas and supporting details.
Plays a short talk and asks students to write a three-line summary.
Gives feedback and previews 8.1 (Responding appropriately in oral communication).

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Respond appropriately in oral communication contexts (e.g., instructions, information, orders)
plan.main_topic: 8.1 Responding appropriately in oral communication
plan.teaching_aids: Oral texts, prompt cards, telephone props.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students how they respond when a teacher gives them an instruction.
Explains appropriate ways of responding to instructions, information and orders (acknowledgement, asking for clarification, politeness).
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes on the response types.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides role plays in which students respond to instructions, information and orders using prompt cards.
Reviews selected role plays and consolidates the response formulae on the board.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present role plays to the class.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.general_objectives: Practise responding appropriately in oral communication
plan.specific_objectives: Practise telephone conversations and panel interview responses
plan.main_topic: 8.1 Responding appropriately in oral communication
plan.teaching_aids: Prompt cards, telephone props, panel cards.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the response types from the first double period.
Models a telephone conversation and a short panel interview, explaining turn-taking and polite response formulae.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the models and note the response formulae.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides telephone conversation practice and mini panel interviews in groups.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Practise telephone and panel exchanges in groups.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews a panel exchange and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Respond to short oral prompts individually
plan.main_topic: 8.1 Responding appropriately in oral communication

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the telephone and panel practice from the double periods.
Clarifies remaining difficulties with polite response formulae.
Holds rapid question-and-answer practice, posing short prompts to individual students.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Respond to short oral prompts individually.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Gives feedback and previews 8.2 (Responding appropriately in written communication).

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Respond appropriately in written communication contexts (e.g., writing responses to questions and messages)
plan.main_topic: 8.2 Responding appropriately in written communication
plan.teaching_aids: Written texts, sample responses, question sheets.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students how they respond in writing when they receive a written message or question.
Explains the features of a good written response (clear, complete, relevant, polite) using sample responses.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes and examine the sample responses.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides individual writing of responses to short written questions and messages.
Reviews written responses, addresses common errors and consolidates on the board.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Exchange written messages and respond to them in pairs
plan.main_topic: 8.2 Responding appropriately in written communication
plan.teaching_aids: Sample messages and notes for exchange.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the features of a good written response.
Models responding to a brief note and a friendly message in writing.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the models and note useful expressions.
teaching_structure.assessment: Correct grasp of written response formats

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pairs in exchanging written messages and responding to each other's message in writing.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Exchange messages and respond in writing.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews samples of the exchanged messages and gives feedback.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Read each other's responses and refine them.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Write short responses to given written questions in class
plan.main_topic: 8.2 Responding appropriately in written communication

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the exchanged messages from the double periods.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Recall how to start and end a written response.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Clarifies common errors in written responses.
Administers a short written-response exercise.
Gives feedback and previews 9.1 (Using appropriate grammar for oral communication).

topics.topic_name: 5A: USING APPROPRIATE GRAMMAR FOR ORAL COMMUNICATION

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.general_objectives: Use appropriate grammar for oral communication
plan.specific_objectives: Use appropriate grammar in oral communication in a variety of contexts (e.g., expressing daily routines, ongoing activities)
plan.main_topic: 9.1 Using appropriate grammar for oral communication
plan.teaching_aids: Dictionaries, pictures, recorded materials, timetable chart.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students to describe orally what they do every morning and listens for grammar.
Explains the simple present (daily routines) and present continuous (ongoing activities) for oral use, with pictures and recorded examples.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes and practise the structures orally.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides an interview practice in which students ask and answer about daily routines and current activities.
Reviews selected interviews, corrects errors on the board and consolidates the structures.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Present short reports of their interviews.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Express daily routines and ongoing activities in a class inquiry
plan.main_topic: 9.1 Using appropriate grammar for oral communication
plan.teaching_aids: Dictionaries, pictures, recorded materials, timetable chart.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the simple present and present continuous structures.
Demonstrates describing a weekly timetable and activities happening now, using pictures and recorded materials.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the demonstration and take notes.
teaching_structure.assessment: Correct use of the structures in description

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Runs a class inquiry in which each student describes a daily routine and a current activity.
Reviews the inquiry, corrects errors and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Short oral grammar practice on daily routines and ongoing activities
plan.main_topic: 9.1 Using appropriate grammar for oral communication

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the class inquiry from the double periods.
Clarifies remaining difficulties with the structures.
Poses oral questions about everyday routines and current activities to individual students.
Gives feedback and previews 9.2 (Using appropriate vocabulary for oral communication).

topics.topic_name: 6A: USING APPROPRIATE VOCABULARY FOR ORAL COMMUNICATION

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.general_objectives: Use appropriate vocabulary for oral communication
plan.specific_objectives: Use appropriate vocabulary for oral communication in a variety of contexts
plan.main_topic: 9.2 Using appropriate vocabulary for oral communication

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Plays a short song and asks students to name new words they heard.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Share new words heard in the song.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Explains choosing appropriate words for different contexts (describing people, objects and places; formal and informal settings) using pictures and dictionaries.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Take notes and look up new words.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides description practice in which students describe pictures and objects using the new vocabulary.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Describe pictures and objects in pairs.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews the descriptions and records the new words on the board.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.general_objectives: Use vocabulary in songs and games
plan.specific_objectives: Practise vocabulary through word games in groups
plan.main_topic: 9.2 Using appropriate vocabulary for oral communication
plan.teaching_aids: Word cards, picture cards, song sheet.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the new vocabulary from the first double period.
Introduces word association, vocabulary bingo and a simple song as ways to learn and use vocabulary, modelling each activity.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the modelling and learn the activity rules.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides groups in playing vocabulary games using word and picture cards.
teaching_structure.assessment: Correct use of vocabulary in the games

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews the games, clarifies misused words and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 4.0 Comprehending oral messages
plan.specific_objectives: Short vocabulary practice using picture cards
plan.main_topic: 9.2 Using appropriate vocabulary for oral communication

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the songs and games from the double periods.
Clarifies the meaning and use of the trickiest words.
Holds quick picture-card naming practice with individual students.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Name the pictures using correct vocabulary.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Gives feedback and previews 10.1 (Creating formal texts).

plan.competence: 5.0 Creating a variety of texts using appropriate tone and register
plan.general_objectives: Create formal texts (e.g., friendly letters and invitations)
plan.specific_objectives: Create formal texts (e.g., friendly letters and invitations) using appropriate tone and register
plan.main_topic: 10.1 Creating formal texts
plan.teaching_aids: Samples of friendly letters and invitations, textbook.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students whether they have ever written a letter or an invitation.
Shows samples of friendly letters and invitations and explains their layout (addresses, date, salutation, body, closing) and polite tone.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Observe the samples and take notes on the layout.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides guided writing of an invitation in pairs.
teaching_structure.assessment: Completeness and politeness of the invitations

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews the written invitations and consolidates the layout on the board.

plan.competence: 5.0 Creating a variety of texts using appropriate tone and register
plan.specific_objectives: Write a friendly letter to a friend using appropriate tone and register
plan.main_topic: 10.1 Creating formal texts
plan.teaching_aids: Sample friendly letter, blank letter paper.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the layout of formal texts.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Recall the parts of a letter.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Models writing a friendly letter and lists common polite expressions used in letters and invitations.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the model and note the expressions.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides individual guided writing of a friendly letter to a friend.
teaching_structure.assessment: Completeness and tone of the letters

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews selected letters and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 5.0 Creating a variety of texts using appropriate tone and register
plan.specific_objectives: Complete a short invitation in class
plan.main_topic: 10.1 Creating formal texts

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the friendly letters from the double periods.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Recall the parts of a letter.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Clarifies remaining difficulties with layout and tone.
Guides students in writing a short invitation to an event.
Gives feedback and previews 10.2 (Creating informal texts).

plan.competence: 5.0 Creating a variety of texts using appropriate tone and register
plan.general_objectives: Create informal texts (e.g., dialogues, daily/weekly timetables)
plan.specific_objectives: Create informal texts (e.g., dialogues, daily/weekly timetables) using appropriate tone and register
plan.main_topic: 10.2 Creating informal texts

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Asks students what a dialogue is and what their daily timetable lists.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Brainstorm ideas about dialogues and timetables.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Explains informal texts (dialogues, daily and weekly timetables) and shows examples, clarifying the informal tone used.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Observe the examples and take notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides pair work in creating a short dialogue from a given scenario.
teaching_structure.assessment: Appropriateness of tone in the dialogues

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews the dialogues through short role plays to the class.

plan.competence: 5.0 Creating a variety of texts using appropriate tone and register
plan.specific_objectives: Write a daily/weekly timetable with activities using appropriate register
plan.main_topic: 10.2 Creating informal texts

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the dialogues from the first double period.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Recall what makes an informal text.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Models a weekly timetable showing daily activities and explains how to record activities in short, clear phrases.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Follow the model and take notes.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Guides individual writing of a weekly timetable of their own activities.
teaching_structure.assessment: Completeness and clarity of the timetables

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Reviews selected timetables and gives feedback.

plan.competence: 5.0 Creating a variety of texts using appropriate tone and register
plan.specific_objectives: Short dialogue practice and preparation for Term II revision
plan.main_topic: 10.2 Creating informal texts

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Recaps the dialogues and timetables from the double periods.
teaching_structure.student_activities: Recall the features of informal texts.

teaching_structure.teacher_activities: Clarifies the difference between formal and informal texts.
Guides short dialogue practice in pairs using prompt cards.
Gives feedback, reviews the Term II work covered and previews the final weeks (revision, mock, FTNA and annual examinations).
teaching_structure.student_activities: Listen to the review and preview.
teaching_structure.assessment: Readiness for the Term II revision
